test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct active form.

"The town was destroyed by the earthquake.”

options.text: The earthquake had destroyed the town.
The earthquake was destroying the town.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Active voice structure: The subject performs the action on the object.
 
• The given sentence in passive voice is: "The town was destroyed by the earthquake."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "the earthquake" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "was destroyed" to the active form "destroyed."
 
• Ensure the object "the town" follows the verb.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The earthquake destroyed the town."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"The earthquake destroys the town." – Incorrect tense (present simple instead of past simple).
 
• **Option 3: **"The earthquake had destroyed the town." – Incorrect tense (past perfect instead of past simple).
 
• **Option 4: **"The earthquake was destroying the town." – Incorrect aspect (past continuous instead of past simple).
